title_sq: Apartament 3+1+3 me verande dhe post parkimi ne shitje tek rezidenca Touch of the Sun !
description_sq:
Shitet apartament modern 3+1+3 i pozicionuar ne katin e 1-re ne rezidencen e njohur Touch of Sun, Mjull-Bathore, Tirane. 
Siperfaqe totale 260m2 nga te cilat: 164.3 m2 neto, 80m2 verande, siperfaqe e perbashket 15.7 m2. Gjithashtu, disponon nje post parkimi dhe nje depo ne katin -1. 
Ambjenti organizohet ne hapsire ndenje, kuzhine e vecuar me ballkon, depo, ambjent shperndares, 3 dhoma gjumi, 3 tualete (njeri nga te cilet ndodhet ne dhomen matrimoniale). Me tej, veranda ka nje hapsire te bollshme me pamje relaksuese nga pishina e kompleksit, e pershtatshme edhe per bbq. Ideale për familje ose investim.
title_en: Apartment 3+1+3 with veranda and parking post for sale at Touch of the Sun residence!
description_en: Modern 3+1+3 apartment for sale, located on the 1st floor in the well-known Touch of Sun residence, Mjull-Bathore, Tirana. Total area 260m2 of which: 164.3 m2 net, 80m2 veranda, total area 15.7 m2. It also has a parking post and a warehouse on the -1st floor. The space is organized in a living room, a separate kitchen with a balcony, a storage room, a distribution area, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms (one of which is in the master bedroom). Furthermore, the veranda has a spacious area with a relaxing view of the pool of the complex, also suitable for bbq. Ideal for family or investment.
